description: Hand-labelled retrieval test set for the fictional StreamNest knowledge base. Queries are written as customers would phrase them (paraphrased, not copied from the docs). relevant_doc_ids lists every document that contains the answer; an empty list means the knowledge base does NOT cover the question, so retrieval should report insufficient evidence. Written by the same author as the documents, which makes it easier than real customer traffic.
